versions.changelog:
Initial release of cross-exchange-arb-scanner:

- Scans live spot bid/ask prices across Coinbase, Kraken, Bitstamp, Gemini, and OKX (no API key needed) to detect arbitrage opportunities for BTC, ETH, SOL, and other supported tokens.
- Flags price discrepancies where the best bid on one exchange exceeds the best ask on another, reporting gross spreads in basis points and which exchanges to buy/sell.
- Supports CLI options to filter by minimum spread or output JSON.
- Excludes fees, withdrawal times, and only surfaces gross top-of-book spreads; real-world costs may erase small opportunities.
- Binance is not included due to API restrictions; some tokens may be unavailable on all venues.
- Scanner is for detection only, not automated trading.
